item.tib: zhi khro rdzu 'phrul dra ba dbal chen po gshed dmar spyi 'dul gyi rgyud las ma mo srid pa spyi 'dul
item.coloph: gsas mkhar srid pa rab 'byams kyi rgyud las/ ma mo srid pa spyi 'dul/ dbal mo las kyi 'khor lo zhes bya ba/ gshen gsang ba 'dus pas/ dbal bon gtso bo yab yum la lung nod nas sum bcu rtsa gsum du gtan la phab pa'o// stang dmu tsha gyer med kyis phyi rabs las ldan gyi gshen la brgyud do/ lha srin dregs pa 'dul ba'i gnyen po/ khro bo gshed dmar spyi 'dul gyi pho nya/ dbal mo srog gi sgrub pa rdzogs so//
